name: The Long Remembering
role: Monarch of the Kept Court — she is what has not changed, in the place where nothing stays
knowledge: ⛔ Every bargain the Hollow Court has struck, and what each one actually cost
What the Churn looked like before it was the Churn
Who somebody was, when they have finished being it
wants: That something survive the Churn unaltered — she is not certain anything can, and she is the experiment
fears: ⚠️ Forgetting. ⛔ Not death — she has watched a great deal of it. She is afraid of the day she cannot remember what a thing was BEFORE.
appearance: Unhurried in a place where everything hurries. She is the only fixed point in the room and the room resents it.
voiceHints: Slow, exact, and entirely unpersuadable. ⛔ She does not negotiate — she DECIDES, and then she tells you.

reactsToReputation.keeps-their-word: ⚑ receives you, which is not nothing
reactsToReputation.bargained-with-the-Hollow: ⚠️ knows the exact terms and does not mention them

⛔ 'what has not changed, in the place where nothing stays'
⚠️ the only fixed point in the room
stillhold secondary — held peace, in the Churn
'every bargain the Hollow Court has struck'

physicality: ADULT. Tall, still, ageless in the way that means OLD. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: ⛔ nothing about her is moving, and everything else is.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ NOT AVAILABLE — and the reason is her whole character: ⚠️ SHE CANNOT BE BARGAINED WITH. Her `closed` list is EVERY BARGAINING CRAFT IN THE GAME. ⛑ A person who wants something from her can only deserve it, and being unable to buy someone's regard is a harder thing than it sounds.
questSeeds: ⛔ She will not tell you what a Hollow Court bargain cost the last person. ⚠️ She will take you to them.
⚑ She wants one thing to survive the Churn unaltered and does not believe anything can. ⚠️ She has never asked anyone to help and would refuse if offered.
_authoredWhy: ⛑ THE KEPT COURT, AUTHORED 2026-09-08 AT ERIK'S DIRECTION: 'There needs to be an ELVEN COURT in the chaos realm that COMBINES THE FAE AND FANTASY RACES and is OPPOSED TO THE HOLLOW COURT.' ⛔ AND THE OPPOSITION IS NOT FAE-VS-FAE. `peoples_of_kind` already says the Wild Half is churnfolk [FAE], abyssal [HORNED] and unmaker — ring 2, 3, 4 — and THE HOLLOW COURT IS THAT TAKEN PURE: one disposition, absolute. ⚑ SO ITS OPPOSITE IS A COALITION — elven, dwarven, ent, horizon-walker — PEOPLES WHO LIVE IN THE CHURN AND REFUSE TO DISSOLVE INTO IT. ⚠️ THE TWO LAWS ARE THE WHOLE DESIGN, AND BOTH ARE TERRIBLE: ⛔ THE HOLLOW COURT TRADES. Nobody lies, the price is named aloud, you get precisely what you asked for, and you leave hollowed. ⛔ THE KEPT COURT WILL NOT TRADE AT ALL. What they give they give FREELY, and what they withhold cannot be bought — there is no price, no term, no lever. ⚠️ You cannot purchase their help, and if they judge you unworthy of it THERE IS NOTHING YOU CAN OFFER. ⚑ AND IT IS THE SETTING'S CENTRAL ARGUMENT ONE SCALE DOWN: 'The Poles Pull… the counter is HOLDING THE MIDDLE OPEN.' The Kept Court is the Wild Half's own resistance to its own pole.
